value.rationale: This full natural smooth axial measure family has a sharp two-threshold phase diagram: the first nontrivial even polynomial tilt beyond quadratic produces interior oblique minimizers for n≥5 and a separate axial/equatorial upper switch for n≥11. It identifies sharp norms and every extremizer for all n≥3 and all positive amplitudes, plus an exact quantitative cone-stability identity. The counterpart quadratic tilt has no oblique optimizer, providing a motivated structural boundary.
